title: Sprout Tweens Bulletin — Spring
summary: Tweens kickoff, the daily-water study habit and camp sign-ups.

items: 13 Sep — Sprout Tweens Kickoff, 11am, upstairs hall
Study habit — the Rooted guide's week on water: read a little every day, like watering a seed
22 Nov — Tweens Camp sign-ups open after service

blocks.text: Roots & Shoots is the tweens' Spring theme, and the study habit is the watering can: a short read from the guide at the same time each day — before school, after homework, at dinner. Teenage roots grow on daily water, not occasional floods. Find your watering time in week two of the guide and hold it for the season.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
A seed is not in a hurry.
